skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of information technology including hardware, software, and systems.
Demonstrate knowledge of how data is represented in computers, including binary numbers, characters, images, and sounds.
Explain the organization of computer systems, including CPU, memory, input/output systems, and system interconnections.
Understand basic concepts of operating systems, including Windows OS.
Apply basic skills in using Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Develop basic programming skills using Python language.
